card.text: Explore Miranda in 3D with cssEarth. Inspect Voyager imagery of Uranus’s small moon, its giant scarps, and its ridged coronae.

introduction.text: Miranda is Uranus’s smallest major moon. Voyager 2 revealed huge fault scarps and three striking regions of ridges and grooves called coronae.

normal.title: Monochrome mosaic
normal.summary: Illumination is corrected, but cast shadows and image seams remain. Detail varies; the gray grid marks missing observations.

elevation.title: Stereo and shading terrain model
elevation.summary: Height from stereo images and shading, relative to the source ellipsoid. Detail varies; gray grid: no measurements.

geology.title: Geologic map
geology.summary: Historical interpreted units; degree-scale registration limits. Gray grid: unmapped or conflicting units.
